issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Lecture.toString(): the problem statement (and standard Java) expects toString() to return a String (see problem_statement.md lines 36-39 and the UML). In the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) the method is declared as 'public Object toString()' (signature at line 64) with an @Override annotation above it. That signature does not match the expected 'public String toString()' and therefore does not correctly override Object.toString(); with the @Override present this causes a compilation error and will confuse students trying to follow the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution method signature to 'public String toString()' and ensure it returns a String. Keep the @Override annotation. For example: '@Override public String toString() { return "Lecture{" + ... + "}"; }' This will align the solution with the problem statement and allow correct overriding and compilation.
